rationale: Reviewed the round-3 commit 8abb8e065ab2eacd505418c7ed0415fd22b73999 in the designated bead worktree. The round-2 approval remains supported. The focused agreement-table suite passed all 13 rows and the doc cross-pin. The full short suite passed serially with `go test -p 1 ./... -short -count=1`; an earlier parallel run timed out only because several unrelated packages blocked concurrently in external `bd` subprocesses, and each of those packages passed on the serial retry. My independent anti-drift probe jointly changed the guide and `agreementTableRows` for `complete -> review (last bead)` from review/review/review to plan/plan/plan while leaving fixture inputs unchanged. The doc cross-pin passed, but the executable fixture correctly went red on status-aware derivation, state show, tail context/template selection, and the new stored-independent `DerivePhaseFromChildren` leg, each producing review while the tampered record expected plan. This empirically confirms commit 8abb8e06 closes the stored-echo circularity in the reviewed lens. Probe scratch was deleted, and the bead worktree remained clean and byte-identical at the reviewed SHA.

findings.title: Joint doc-and-record tamper is caught by independent executable surfaces
findings.evidence: Using a Go overlay and a /tmp document copy, changed the `complete -> review (last bead)` guide cells and agreementTableRows record together from review to plan. `TestAgreementTable_DocRowsCrossPinFixtures` passed as expected for the coordinated edit, while the row fixture failed with actual review versus wanted plan on DerivePhaseWithStatus-class derivation, ResolveModeWithCache state show, tail context, template selector, and phase.DerivePhaseFromChildren. The probe exited red for the intended assertions.

findings.title: Agreement suite and complete short suite pass
findings.evidence: `go test ./internal/phase -run 'TestAgreementTable' -count=1 -v` passed all 13 row subtests and the doc cross-pin. `go test -p 1 ./... -short -count=1` exited 0 for every package. `go build ./...` also completed successfully before the initial parallel test attempt.

findings.title: Reviewed-worktree and scratch hygiene verified
findings.evidence: After the probe, the exact scratch files and directory under /tmp were removed. `git status --short` was empty, `git diff --exit-code` succeeded, and HEAD remained 8abb8e065ab2eacd505418c7ed0415fd22b73999.
